messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Metformin is prescribed particularly for those with insulin resistance.
Metformin is prescribed particularly for those with fertility difficulties.
Metformin is backed by extensive research.
Metformin is backed by clinical guidelines.
Metformin helps regulate cycles.
Metformin supports ovulation.
Metformin may help reduce androgen-related symptoms.
Androgen-related symptoms include acne.
Androgen-related symptoms include excess hair growth.
Metformin can aid with weight management.
This weight management aid is for those affected by PCOS-related weight gain.
Triplet: ["Metformin", "prescribed for", "insulin resistance"]

The relation 'prescribed for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is indicated or recommended for the treatment or management of the object condition.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'applies to patients who are to be managed with': The subject drug is used for patients who are to be managed with the procedure or treatment specified by the object entity.
C. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'has use indication': The subject drug may be used for the medical purpose or indication specified by the object entity.
E. 'has related treatment guide': The subject drug is associated with the medical treatment guide specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
